description: Search ArmorNGlory's catalog of modern Christian streetwear and faith apparel. Use for requests like 'Christian trucker hat', 'Bible verse t-shirt', 'Christian hoodie', 'faith-based gym shirt', 'Christian Crocs / foam clogs', 'Philippians 4:13 shirt', or 'non-cheesy Christian clothing'. Covers scripture trucker hats and dad caps, heavyweight graphic tees, hoodies and sweatshirts, EVA foam clogs, activewear, phone cases, and wall art. Filter by keyword, Bible verse, category, aesthetic, occasion, color, size, or price. Returns product links, prices, images, the meaning behind each design, and 1-click checkout links.

aesthetic.description: Style vibe filter (e.g. 'Streetwear', 'Minimalist Core', 'Sacred Symbols', 'Gothic Faith', 'Vintage Americana', 'Athletic')

category.description: Category filter (e.g. 'Hats & Headwear', 'Footwear & Clogs', 'T-Shirts & Tops', 'Hoodies & Sweatshirts', 'Phone Cases', 'Activewear & Training', 'Wall Art & Decor', 'Accessories')

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default: 5, max: 25)
